# Homeswift

> The HomeKit Accessory Protocol in Swift, and a Homebridge written in Swift on top of it: one small binary that runs a Homebridge-style config.json and the plugins compiled into it, with a web UI, an optional AI Assistant, an MCP server and an optional Matter bridge for Google Home, Alexa and Home Assistant. macOS 14+ and Linux; Docker images for amd64 and arm64, and a Synology package. MIT licence.

Its MCP server lets Claude (as a connector in claude.ai and the Claude apps, over OAuth) or any MCP client see and run every accessory. Anything destructive asks the user first; locks, garage doors and alarms change only through one guarded tool; every change is written to an audit log; text from devices and logs is treated as data, never as instructions.

Homeswift is an independent project, not made or endorsed by Apple. Without MFi certification, the Home app shows its accessories as uncertified when they are added.

## Pages

- [Home](https://homeswift.dev/): AI agents and the Assistant running a HomeKit home, with a live demo
- [The bridge](https://homeswift.dev/bridge.html): Homebridge rewritten in Swift, benchmarks against HAP-NodeJS, features, plugins, install

Both are also in French (https://homeswift.dev/fr/), Spanish (https://homeswift.dev/es/) and Portuguese (https://homeswift.dev/pt/).

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/mp-consulting/homeswift/blob/main/README.md): what the library does, installing it, a first accessory in Swift
- [Writing and porting plugins](https://github.com/mp-consulting/homeswift/blob/main/docs/plugins.md): the plugin API, the runtime's files, porting a Homebridge plugin from Node.js
- [The web UI](https://github.com/mp-consulting/homeswift/blob/main/docs/ui.md): configuration, pages, accounts and security
- [The MCP server](https://github.com/mp-consulting/homeswift/blob/main/docs/mcp.md): scopes, confirmations, OAuth for claude.ai and the Claude apps
- [The Assistant](https://github.com/mp-consulting/homeswift/blob/main/docs/ai.md): providers, the command line, what reaches a provider
- [Synology](https://github.com/mp-consulting/homeswift/blob/main/docs/synology.md): the package and the container on a NAS
